narrative: Builders shipped 6,475 new Spaces this week (−0.7%), with every one of them classified (100.0% of 6,475). Chat and assistants remains the largest named use case at 955, though image generation was the one to add volume (+9.7%). On the demand side, scientific research took a larger slice of new Spaces (+1.1 points) while enterprise productivity and healthcare both took smaller ones. Static pages and Gradio still carry nearly all shipping, and Spaces picked up 895 likes (+46.7%).
